fix_task 1 correlacion-desalojo-victima-probable: RESOLVED. Scenario 8, renamed TestDesalojoDeCorrelacionIncrementaContactosOmitidosYDesalojaLaMasAntigua, now sends corr-0000 alone into contact conv-vieja at t=0, then 1024 sends into conv-unica at t=1..1024. At the 1024th send len(correlaciones)==1024 triggers desalojarCorrelacion; corr-0000 is the unique minimum creadaMs, so it is the victim. The subsequent ObservarAcuse(corr-0000) is a no-op and conv-vieja reads acusados/enviados = 0/1 = 0.00. Under a newest-first mutation corr-0000 survives, the ack resolves, and conv-vieja reads 1/1 = 1.00. The two branches print genuinely different text under %.2f, so the old 1/1025-also-rounds-to-0.00 vacuity is gone. Arithmetic checked against the real numbers in the test, not the commit message.

fix_task 2 correlacion-desempate-id-ascendente: RESOLVED. New scenario TestDesalojoDeCorrelacionDesempataPorIdAscendente pins relojFalso at 700 and never calls avanzar, so all 1024 correlations (corr-0000 in conv-vieja plus corr-0001..corr-1023 in conv-unica) carry identical creadaMs=700. The primary comparison corr.creadaMs < marcaVictima can therefore never fire and only the ascending-id tiebreak can select a victim; corr-0000 is the lexicographic minimum and is evicted, so conv-vieja reads 0.00. Reversing the tiebreak to descending picks corr-1023, corr-0000 survives, and conv-vieja reads 1.00. The scenario genuinely exercises the tiebreak branch.

The two scenarios are correctly orthogonal, which corroborates the reported mutation results: scenario 8's primary comparison is decisive (corr-0000 uniquely oldest) so a descending-id mutation leaves it green, and scenario 12's entries are all tied so a newest-first mutation leaves it green. Each mutation is caught by exactly one test.

No new vacuous assertion introduced. buscarClave calls t.Fatalf when the key is absent, so an ack_ratio.conv-vieja assertion cannot pass by the key silently going missing. Contact eviction cannot interfere in either scenario (2 contacts against MaximoContactos=256).
